title: Peru: Sekoya Pop dominates ranking of most exported varieties, 2024/25 season
summary: Reports Proarandanos figures for Peruvian blueberry exports in the 2024/25 season to week 33: Sekoya Pop leads with 2,514 tonnes, or 19 percent of national volume; Eureka accounts for 655 tonnes, about 5 percent; and Eureka Sunrise appears under two separate codes, 'Ridley 160' with 714 tonnes and 'Ridley 1602' with 183 tonnes.
why_it_matters: Third-party volume data from a national producer association is the closest available proxy for actual commercial adoption, as distinct from announced launches. The duplicate coding of Eureka Sunrise in the same table is itself a data-quality finding and means the two figures must not be summed without confirmation.

reading.rationale: Rare variety-level volume data showing which genetics have actually reached scale.

commercial_position.rationale: Volume share in the largest exporting country is the strongest available adoption signal.

monitoring.rationale: Seasonal data that should be refreshed each year.
